text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with BTC's 1.3% decline outpacing ETH's 0.8% loss, suggesting traders are rotating away from risk or holding cash. The Fear & Greed index is at extreme fear (10) and has deteriorated sharply over the week, signaling capitulation sentiment despite relatively contained daily losses. Bitcoin dominance remains elevated at 59.4% with $109B in daily volume, reflecting a defensive posture where capital is clustering in the largest, most liquid assets.
